people.name: Sanballat
people.line: Governor of Samaria, opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding of Jerusalem

translations.web: But when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and was very indignant, and mocked the Jews.
translations.bsb: Now when Sanballat heard that we were rebuilding the wall, he was furious and filled with indignation. He ridiculed the Jews
translations.kjv: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.
translations.asv: But it came to pass that, when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.
